changeControlRules.netNewContent: write to content/ as status: draft, human flips to published
changeControlRules.comment: Low-risk SEO fixes become PRs. Net-new content lands as draft. Nothing risky publishes itself.

guardrails.zeroHallucination: Every stat, name, URL and claim must be sourced inline or it does not ship. When unsure, flag it.
guardrails.brandVoice: Yuri Kruman voice. No Oxford comma. No em dash. Direct, opinionated, no filler.
guardrails.icp: Busy mid-career enterprise executives (CHRO/VP People and adjacent leaders) who are late to AI, have dabbled, and are anxious about obsolescence.
guardrails.redditRules: Never post programmatically. Drafts only, to the approval queue. Genuine value, never promotional slop. Respect each subreddit's self-promotion rules.
guardrails.noVanityMetrics: Optimize for outcomes (qualified traffic, signups, citations), not activity counts.

cadencePlan.note: No runs scheduled Friday evening through Saturday night. Weekly sync runs Sunday morning (start of Yuri's work week).
